title: console record page v3: frameless detail sections, one merged timeline (discussion + activity + field changes), compact related cards, header 1 primary + 2 secondary + ⋯ — the synthesized default page, drawn from the object's roles; the dead BuildPageOptions hints go
body:
Fenced: #27069 — the `relatedLists` default order and the `fieldGroups` relationship-placement entry wait for that spec key; the derived order and `relatedList: 'primary'` / `inlineEdit` stand in, and the PR lands as `Part of` with that half left on this card. #27052 (PR #27120) and #26679 (PR #27038) are on `main` as of 2026-10-28T10:48Z; dispatched from the epic session on the maintainer's instruction (verbatim 2026-10-28: 「走第一条」).

Part of the record-page-v3 epic #26676 (v3 child 2 of 8). Runs after #27052 (reads the column toggles) and after #26679's PR lands (shared `RecordDetailView.tsx` regions).

## Source (origin/main `7bb8084590`)

- Details: `buildDefaultDetails` (`buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`) emits `record:details` sections drawn as bordered cards (`DetailSection.tsx`), one per `fieldGroups` entry, columns by `autoLayout.ts` (1–4 by field count); empty fields fold per section (`EmptySectionsFold.tsx`).
- Timeline: the default page composes `record:discussion` (comments) and, behind `enable.trackHistory`, a History tab; `showActivity` is never passed by the console (`git grep` empty), so the activity stream (`sys_activity`, `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`) is reachable only from authored pages. Three streams, three places.
- Related: `record:related_list` draws a table with a column header and the object's list columns even in the 20 rem related column (#26758 added `relatedListCompact.ts` to keep it readable); counts in the card header; 「View All」 footer.
- Header: `page:header` draws every `record_header` action as a button plus a refresh button; highlights up to 4 (`deriveHighlightFields`).
- `BuildPageOptions` carries `showReferenceRail` / `hideReferenceRail` / `hideRelatedTab` / `relatedLayout` / `hideHighlights` / `hidePath` / `recordChrome` and a `rightRail` slot that no console caller passes (only tests and a Studio seed); ADR-0085 says those surface hints are not admitted; `rightRail` is not in the spec's strict slot enum.

## Target (the design: canvas board RecordPageV3 / RecordPageV3NoTimeline / RecordPageRef)

1. Header: name (+ `imageField` avatar or initials) + object chip + copy id; actions from `actions` with `record_header` → the first is the primary (filled), the next two secondary (outlined), the rest and `record_more` and refresh go into ⋯; highlights up to 6 in an equal-width grid; the stage path below (terminal state drawn apart — #26612 owns the path internals).
2. Details column: sections are a title + a hairline + a field grid (no card border, no shadow), 1–3 columns by field count, collapsible; empty fields fold per section as today; sections that are entirely empty collapse into one line 「地址 · 转化 · 附加信息 · N 个空分区 · 展开」; the meta line (created / updated / owner / id) sits at the column bottom.
3. Timeline column: ONE stream merging discussion (`enable.feeds`), activity (`enable.activities`, `sys_activity`) and field changes (`trackHistory`); filter chips 全部 / 活动 / 讨论 / 变更 on the column title; the composer on top; system entries (field change, created) compact single lines in muted text; 「查看全部 N 条 →」 at the bottom. The separate History tab and the detail-bottom discussion go; in the tabbed tier the stream is the 时间线 tab (second for a worked object, last otherwise).
4. Related column (default order = the object's `relatedLists`, #27069, then the derived order): each related list is a compact card — title + count + ＋ in one row, no table header, up to 3 rows of name + one status / date chip, ⤢ to enlarge in place (item 9); `relatedList: 'primary'` lists first, then declaration order; approvals, attachments and the 「动态」 fold (when the timeline column is OFF) at the column bottom. Columns `1.25fr : 1fr : 320px`.
5. Delete the dead `BuildPageOptions` hints and the `rightRail` slot from `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` and its exports (ADR-0085); the opt-in `record:reference_rail` node stays for authored pages. A changeset names the removed options (patch; `Metadata-protocol: none` — they were never metadata).
6. Drawer / tabbed tier: tabs 详情 / 时间线 / 关联 /（审批 when requests exist）; the same header.
7. Related cards are the reader's to arrange (maintainer, 2026-10-28, on Claude Code's side panels: 「其中的内容面板很像我们的相关表，我发现用户可以上线拖拽换顺序，这需要考虑吗」): each card collapses to its title + count (a collapsed card fetches no rows), and on desktop the title row is a drag handle to reorder cards with a drop line; keyboard: 上移 / 下移 / 折叠 in the card's ⋯ menu. Order and collapsed state are stored per user × object through #27052's workspace-preference module with 「恢复默认顺序」; the author's default order (`primary` first, then declaration order) is what a reader who never dragged sees. The same order and collapsed state apply in the tabbed tier's 关联 tab; mobile gets collapse only (no drag) in #27058.
   Merge rules (maintainer, 2026-10-28, on 「如果让用户自己定义排序，那和默认顺序冲突怎么办？开发了新的子表之后怎么办」): the default order is the author's `relatedLists` (#27069) over the derived order; the reader's preference stores a DIFF — `{ order: [relationship ids], collapsed: [ids], basedOn: hash of the default order }`, ids being `object.field` — and the display is the default order with the reader's `order` laid over it: dragged cards keep the reader's relative order, untouched cards keep their default relative position; a later change to the author's default never reorders a reader's dragged cards, 「恢复默认顺序」 does. A relationship that is new since the reader last dragged is inserted after the nearest card that precedes it in the default order and exists in the reader's order (first in default → first), carries a 「新」 badge for 48 h, and takes the default collapsed state; a relationship that no longer exists is dropped from `order` on the next write. When `basedOn` differs from the current default's hash the column title shows a quiet 「默认顺序已更新 · 恢复默认」 hint.
8. Body tables vs side cards (maintainer, 2026-10-28: 「如果是一个报价单，明细行的子表放在右侧合适嘛？」): a related list that is the record's own body — `master_detail` with `inlineEdit` on the FK, or any list the author marks `relatedList: 'primary'` — is drawn as a full-width table section in the details column after the field sections (all columns, paging, inline edit where the FK allows, a totals row for numeric columns); every other list is a side card. Placement inside the details column (maintainer, 2026-10-28: 「他如果做到放在基本信息下面，而条款和备注在后面」「如果有多个子表呢」): by default every body table is inserted right after the FIRST field group (conventionally 基本信息), body tables stacked in `relatedLists` order (else the derived order), each its own section (title + count + ＋ + ⤢, first page of 10 rows with in-table paging, collapsible per reader, not draggable — the author's order is the document's structure), and the remaining field groups follow; an author who needs a table elsewhere places it through a `fieldGroups` entry that references the relationship (#27069). On mobile the body tables stack in the 详情 tab, each collapsed to title + count by default. Quote → quote line items, opportunity → line items, price book → entries land in the body on HotCRM once their FK declares `inlineEdit` or `relatedList: 'primary'` (a hotcrm follow-up after #27069).
9. Enlarge a side card in place — ONE path (maintainer, 2026-10-28: 「放大看子表全部记录和更多列，我觉得一条路就可以吧？放大之后，如果你决策必要，可以再加第二条路。」): a card's ⤢ (and its count chip) opens that related list as a full-width table over the page body (the header stays, details / timeline step aside), with all columns, paging, sort and inline edit — the full `RelatedList` face the old Related tab drew — addressed by `?related=object.field`; Esc or ‹ returns to the columns. The card footer's 「查看全部 N 条 →」 is removed; the child object's list page is reached from navigation only (the existing `onViewAll` host hook stays for other hosts, unused by the console card).
10. Hide a side card per reader (maintainer: 「有需要隐藏某个子表的场景吗？怎么处理」): the card's ⋯ menu offers 「隐藏」, stored in the arrangement as `hidden: [ids]`; the column's last line reads 「已隐藏 N 张 · 显示」 to bring them back. Author-level hiding stays `relatedList: false` on the FK; unreadable children stay out by `canRead`.

## File surface

`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, `recordPageColumns.ts`, `RecordPageColumns.tsx`, `DetailSection.tsx` / `DetailSectionNode.tsx` / `EmptySectionsFold.tsx` (frameless), a merged-timeline renderer beside `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` / `RecordComments.tsx` / `HistoryTimeline.tsx`, `RelatedList.tsx` compact face + `relatedListCompact.ts`, `ui/packages/components` `page:header` renderer (action cap), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (feed / history reads for the merged stream), i18n, tests beside, changesets; ⛔ `packages/spec/**`.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: header action cap (4 actions → 1 + 2 + ⋯); frameless section rendering and the empty-sections line; merged stream ordering and the four filters; compact related card (3 rows, header-less, 「查看全部」); `BuildPageOptions` no longer accepts the removed keys (tsc).
2. Screenshots of a HotCRM lead at 1440 (three columns), the same at 1100 (two columns), and in the drawer; a product at 1440.
3. #26758's tier tests still pass.

## Rulings (maintainer, chat in the filing session, 2026-10-28 — verbatim, not re-decidable here)

1. Record-page model (2026-10-27): 「1. 一个对象一个默认打开方式：默认抽屉（带展开整页），`page` 只给显式声明的对象，`modal` 退役，split / popover 变成用户个人偏好；抽屉和整页是同一张页在两个宽度。」
2. On the resident timeline column: 「时间线是不是太突出了，这个只适合部分对象吧？适合做所有业务对象的默认布局吗」 and then 「时间线是否显示，是否可以切换，比如当前版本的 Claude code，顶部有很多切换图标」 — the column's presence is a per-user toggle with an object-derived default, never metadata.
3. On the related column's cost: 「关联都放在右侧，记录打开时是不是会很慢，因为需要加载所有的关联子表。」 — the related column loads counts first, rows on demand, and never blocks the details.
4. On mobile: 「还要考虑手机端的效果。」
5. On the definition surfaces: the PM's keep / narrow / retire table was put to the maintainer (keep object roles, relationship flags, six slotted slots and `kind: full`; retire the `tabs` slot and the dead `BuildPageOptions` hints; fold the quick-look path into the one record page) and approved with the instruction in the footer.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-28 under epic #26676 (record page v2 → v3), from the record-page definition-surface inventory on objectstack main `7bb8084590` and the maintainer's rulings in that session. The maintainer's instruction to file and dispatch, verbatim: 「同意，以上界面相关的需要我确认的你负责立卡派发，如果有可能可以启动云会话，开发完你来确认。」 Design evidence: the design canvas boards 「记录页 v3」 row (RecordPageV3, RecordPageV3NoTimeline, RecordPageRef, RecordDrawerV3, RecordMobile) — exported to the never-merged branch named in the epic parent once this batch is filed.</sub>
